title: Sweet Corn Ice Cream - Unexpected But So Good
body:
I know what you're thinking. Corn? In ice cream? Trust me. TRUST ME. Your taste buds will thank you.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups sweet corn
- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 3/4 cup sugar
- 5 egg yolks
- Vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Steps:
1. Steep corn in warm cream 1 hour
2. Strain, pressing to extract flavor
3. Heat corn-infused cream
4. Temper egg yolks with cream
5. Cook to 170F
6. Chill and churn in ice cream maker
